name: Game_Init_BgmStart
note: calls fmt load and stream start at game init

name: Sound_Init
note: copies 60B cfg; opens ./thbgm.dat; requires ZWAV/1/0x800 header

name: Archive_LoadBlob
note: loads bgm/thbgm.fmt and other archive members

name: Bgm_FindTrackIndex
note: strips dir + strcmp vs fmt names (stride 0x34); returns 0 when not found

name: RIFF_FindChunk
note: chunk finder used by file-mode setup

name: Bgm_LoadFmt
note: loads bgm/thbgm.fmt; stores ptr at +0x1F84; no count or format validation

name: Bgm_StartStream
note: starts the DirectShow stream over the container

name: Bgm_PreloadTrack
note: malloc preload_bytes + ReadFile from +0x10; needs option bit13

name: Bgm_LoadTrack
note: memory-mode graph rebuild or file-mode reuse

name: Bgm_PumpThread
note: thread pumping queue and DS notifications; arg 1 = loop-enabled refill

name: DS_BuildGraphFileMode
note: file-mode DirectShow graph over whole blob

name: DS_FillBuffer
note: alloc + read PCM + Receive; silence fill via rec+0x2E

name: DS_HandleWaveStreamNotification
note: refill on underrun; loop seek at 0x472FB0

name: DS_ReadPCM
note: file: ReadFile clamped to obj+8; memory: memcpy clamped to size

name: Scene_StageStart_BGMSelect
note: .std +0x290/+0x310/+0x390 by name; baked table when scene bit14 set

name: Scene_Update_BGM
note: re-selects BGM; reads both baked tables

name: Menu_SpellGrid
note: builds 15-per-row spell-card grid; sets DAT_0164D0B4 or= 0x4001

name: Log_Printf
note: emits Sound : and error trace lines

name: Mem_CallocDbg
note: allocator used by preload (file tag global.h)

name: g_ZwavBaseOffset
note: base offset of ZWAV blob; 0 and no writer; nonzero would use th08.dat name

name: g_SceneBgmGate
note: non-zero gates the whole stage-BGM selection block in Scene_StageStart_BGMSelect

name: g_SceneFlags
note: bit14 selects baked BGM table (set with bit0 via or 0x4001)

name: g_SceneKeyId
note: key for 0x4C7670 selection; validated vs per-stage windows 119-122/147-150/191-193/213

name: g_StageSelData
note: stage unlock structure used in stage-select loop

name: StageBgmTable
note: theme/boss/third triples in music-room numbering; rows = stages 1-5 then 6a and 6b then extra

name: BakedBgmByKey
note: fields key/music_idx/name/type/flag; selects first entry with key >= g_SceneKeyId

name: s_bgm_init_err
note: error path string used from the 0x0043ABD7 region
